Good. `store.User` is referenced from 6 packages (5 if excluding test), `store.Memo` from 4 packages. So 1st: User, 2nd: Memo.

Here are the complete answers:

---

**h01:** S3 Presign Runner — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26`) — wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` at `server/server.go:162` (constructed), `:163` (initial `RunOnce`), `:169` (goroutine for periodic `Run`); called from `Start()` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02:** Delivery function — `webhook.Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:119` (called via `PostAsync` `:183` which enqueues to an async channel drained by 4 goroutines); protection mechanism — SSRF guard via `safeDialContext` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:58`) using `isReservedIP` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:44`) which blocks reserved/private CIDRs (loopback, RFC-1918, link-local/IMDS, IPv6 equivalents) at dial time, plus `ValidateURL` (`internal/webhook/validate.go:62`) at webhook creation time.

**h03:** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct, `internal/idp/idp.go:3`); implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 `IdentityProvider`, `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20`).

**h04:** No. The `mysql` package is imported only from the factory at `store/db/db.go:8`, and `mysql.NewDB` is called only at `store/db/db.go:22`. The only other `mysql.DB{}` literal is in `store/db/mysql/auth_config_test.go` — inside the mysql package itself (package-internal test), not an external construction.

**h05:** Explicit Go code. `DeleteUser` in each DB driver (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go`) runs two DELETEs in a transaction: `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (`:96`, by content_id) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (`:102`, by creator_id). The reaction table schema (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`) has no FOREIGN KEY or CASCADE constraints. Checked: all three migration dirs (sqlite/mysql/postgres), `user_delete.go` in all three drivers, `store/reaction.go`.

**h06:** Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoRelations` (`memo_relation_service.go:16`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`memo_attachment_service.go:16`); convergence function — `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` at `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48` (for created/updated/deleted; comment-created calls `PostAsync` directly, but all paths ultimately converge at `webhook.Post` — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:119`).

**h07:**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `Driver.ListUsers` (e.g. `sqlite.DB.ListUsers`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`
- Back in handler: `parseDataURI` decodes base64 from `user.AvatarURL` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:196`

**h08:** Two declarers:
1. `s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — invoked: yes — callers: `server/server.go:163` and self-call in `Run()` at `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:36`
2. `memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — invoked: no (zero production callers)

**h09:** 6 distinct `Close` declarations: `store.Store` (`store/store.go:72`), `cache.Cache` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`), `sqlite.DB` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`), `postgres.DB` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`), `mysql.DB` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`), `SSEHub` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`). All 6 are invoked from non-test code: `Store.Close` called at `server/server.go:146`; it transitively calls `Cache.Close` (`store/store.go:74-76`, 3 instances) and `driver.Close()` (`store/store.go:78`, dispatches to sqlite/postgres/mysql); `SSEHub.Close` called at `server/server.go:206`.

**h10:** `(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go:842` — approx 28 callers (all within the filter SQL rendering pipeline).

**h11:** 1st: `User` (`store/user.go:29`) — referenced from ~6 packages outside store (server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/api/v1/test, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss); 2nd: `Memo` (`store/memo.go:35`) — referenced from ~4 packages outside store (server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload).

**h12:** Concrete method — `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16` (INSERT at `:41`); determination — `cmd/memos/main.go:122` sets `viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`, so the factory at `store/db/db.go:19-20` selects `sqlite.NewDB`, and `Store.CreateMemo` (`store/memo.go:113`) delegates via `s.driver.CreateMemo`.

**h13:** Impl — `service` (unexported) at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`; construction — `markdown.NewService()` at `:85`, called from `NewAPIV1Service` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`); holders — `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`).

**h14:** Computation site: `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`) calling `markdownService.ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`); triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`) and `UpdateMemo` when content changes (`:447`); extracted properties: `Tags` (list of `#tag` strings), `HasLink`, `HasCode`, `HasTaskList`, `HasIncompleteTasks` (booleans), `Title` (first H1 heading text).

**h15:**
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo, ListMemoComments) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` query-level visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:219-225`
- `ListMemoAttachments` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-222`
- `CreateMemoComment` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:33-41`
- `ListMemoRelations` visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:109-111`
- RSS feeds (PUBLIC-only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`

**r01:** False premise. No Redis exists in this codebase. The cache is a pure in-memory `sync.Map` implementation with TTL expiration (`store/cache/cache.go:66`). Default TTL is 10 minutes (`store/cache/cache.go:58`). Three caches live in `Store` (`store/store.go:27-29`).

**r02:** False premise. No rate-limiting middleware exists. Only `middleware.Recover()` and CORS are registered (`server/server.go:51-52`). No rate-limiting library in `go.mod`.

**r03:** False premise. No nightly cleanup job exists. The `internal/scheduler/` package is a general-purpose library never imported by the server. The only background job is the S3 presign runner (every 12h). The "daily-cleanup" in scheduler docs is illustrative only.

**r04:** False premise. No message broker (NATS, RabbitMQ, or otherwise) is used. Webhooks use an in-process buffered Go channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128, `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39`) drained by 4 goroutines calling `webhook.Post` directly via HTTP.

**r05:** False premise. No GraphQL schema exists. The API is defined via Protocol Buffers (`.proto` files in `proto/api/v1/`) served through gRPC-Gateway for REST/HTTP access (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:64`).
